title: Taishi Ci Fights the Little Conqueror; Sun Ce Cuts Out a Kingdom
summary: Sun Ce pawns his father's Imperial Seal to Yuan Shu for three thousand men and crosses the Yangtze with them. In a year he has the whole south-east.

At Shenting he and Taishi Ci fight alone in the hills until Sun Ce has Taishi Ci's halberd and Taishi Ci has Sun Ce's helmet, and neither can throw the other; Sun Ce takes him prisoner later and makes him a friend the same day. He lets him go on his word to return, and everyone tells him he is a fool, and Taishi Ci comes back at noon exactly.
history: Substantially historical, including the release of Taishi Ci on parole. The seal was really used as security for the loan.

pins.note: Crosses the Yangtze with three thousand borrowed men.
Joins him with troops and grain; they are the same age.
Fights Sun Ce to a standstill, then serves him.
Holds the Imperial Seal as security, and begins to have ideas.
